title: Poxy bowsy
html_source:
It’s used as a generalised insult for a “low life”, guttersnipe etc. Probably deriving from “boozy”, it’s often heard in combination e.g. “Ye poxy bowsy”.

Most used in Dublin but understood all over the country.
